summary: Continuity improvements for interrupted Emoji key morphs.

changes.title: Interruptible key motion
changes.detail: Rapid panel reversal begins at the last drawn key position, rather than snapping to the previous target.

changes.title: Rendering safety
changes.detail: Optional morph artwork restores native icons when repeated animator callback gaps are large. No full-panel fade.

changes.title: Adaptive Touch groundwork
changes.detail: Added a bounded clustered Gaussian mathematical kernel and synthetic tests. Personalized touch is not enabled in the input path yet.
